text:
{collection}.{field}: the rule version of {type_id} changes from {from} to {to}.
A new rule version needs a migration that every member runs first, and there is none yet.
Add a new field with rule version {to} instead, and deprecate {collection}.{field}.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses the change against the previous lock, and in the error of opening with a lock the database refuses against the one it was last opened with: a field moves to another rule version of its type.
